caption_L1: Here a bar diagram is named Countries with the highest density of nursing and midwifery personnel worldwide in the period 2009 - 2018 (per 10,000 population). There is a linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 200 along the x-axis, labeled Personnel per 10,000 population. A categorical scale starting with Australia and ending with Uzbekistan can be found along the y-axis, marked Country.
caption_L2L3: Monaco was the only country to have over 200 personal per every 10,000 population in the period of 2009-2018. Ireland and Finland score similarly and so did Australia and Luxemburg.
